entities.name: Chintaman Vinayak Vaidya
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chintaman Vinayak Vaidya was a Marathi-language historian and writer from Bombay Presidency, British India. He was Chief Justice of Gwalior State for a period. He was born in a Chitpavan Brahmin family.
